text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates

text: I think, therefore I am.
author: René Descartes

text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
author: Socrates

text: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

text: Happiness is not something ready-made. It comes from your own actions.
author: Dalai Lama

text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
author: Seneca

text: No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.
author: Heraclitus

text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
author: Buddha

author: Oscar Wilde

text: After all, tomorrow is another day.
author: Scarlett O'Hara

text: It is not our abilities that show what we truly are. It is our choices.
author: Albus Dumbledore
source: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

author: Rafiki

author: Roy Mustang

author: Kenshin Himura

author: Itachi Uchiha

text: When do you think people die? When they are forgotten.
author: Dr. Hiluluk

author: Aristotle

text: You is kind. You is smart. You is important.
author: Aibileen Clark

text: Life is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you're gonna get.
author: Forrest Gump

text: If the king doesn't move, then his subjects won't follow.
author: Lelouch Vi Britannia

text: If strength is justice, then is powerlessness a crime?
author: Lelouch Vi Britannia

author: Richard P. Feynman

text: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself.
author: Richard P. Feynman

text: I learned very early the difference between knowing the name of something and knowing something.
author: Richard P. Feynman

text: I would rather have questions that can't be answered than answers that can't be questioned.
author: Richard P. Feynman

text: Religion is a culture of faith; science is a culture of doubt.
author: Richard P. Feynman

text: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
author: Oscar Wilde

text: Two things are infinite: the universe and human stupidity; and I'm not sure about the universe.
author: Albert Einstein

text: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

text: Without music, life would be a mistake.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: There are only two ways to live your life. One is as though nothing is a miracle. The other is as though everything is a miracle.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
author: Mark Twain

text: The fool doth think he is wise, but the wise man knows himself to be a fool.
author: William Shakespeare

text: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, today is a gift of God, which is why we call it the present.
author: Bill Keane

author: Mother Teresa

text: We don't see things as they are, we see them as we are.
author: Anaïs Nin

text: All animals are equal, but some animals are more equal than others.
author: George Orwell

text: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
author: George Orwell

text: Who controls the past controls the future: who controls the present controls the past.
author: George Orwell

author: George Orwell

text: If you want a picture of the future, imagine a boot stamping on a human face—forever.
author: George Orwell

text: The object of power is power.
author: George Orwell

text: Freedom is something that only the individual can give to themselves. No one can hand it to you, and no one can take it if you truly hold it.
author: Eren Yaeger

author: Eren Yaeger

text: Dedicate your hearts. Give up on the idea of living a comfortable life.
author: Erwin Smith

text: The world will always be cruel. But there is beauty in choosing to move forward anyway.
author: Levi Ackerman

author: Light Yagami

author: L

author: L

author: Light Yagami

text: The future is not something we find. It is something we make — one choice at a time.

text: Time is the cruelest thief. It takes everything from you without asking permission.

author: Mayuri Shiina

text: Fate is not a chain that binds us. It is a current that we must learn to swim against — or with.

author: Roy Mustang

text: The world only moves forward because someone, somewhere, refused to accept that it couldn't.
author: C.C.

author: Lelouch Vi Britannia

text: The greatest questions are not the ones that have answers. They are the ones that change the way you see everything.
author: Gon Freecss

text: The world is vast and indifferent. But that is not a reason to despair — it is a reason to explore.
author: Killua Zoldyck

text: Understanding another person is harder than conquering any enemy. It requires a kind of strength that has no name.
author: Gon Freecss

text: Society is a machine. It runs on rules that most people never question. The question is whether you are a gear — or someone who builds something new.
author: Kagari Ama

author: Morpheus

text: An idea is like a virus, resilient, highly contagious. Once an idea has taken hold of the brain, it's almost impossible to eradicate.
author: Dom Cobb

text: The smallest unit of change is a single person deciding to see the world differently. Everything else follows from that.
author: Tyler Durden

text: You don't really follow a magician. You follow the obsession. The obsession is everything.
author: Cutter

text: Every magic trick consists of three parts. The pledge, the turn, and the prestige. Life is no different.
author: Cutter

text: I've never felt more human than when I've been with you. And that scares me.
author: Theodore

text: The painful thing about memory is not that it changes, but that it stays the same while everything around it does.
author: Joel Barish
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: How do I live without the ones I love? Time still turns the pages of the book it's burnt.
author: Cooper

text: In an entire lifetime, you will never know the truth. But you can know the truth about yourself. And that might be enough.
author: Truman Burbank

text: You erase a memory, you don't erase the feeling. The feeling is deeper than the thought that created it.
author: Clementine Kruczynski
source: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind (2004)

text: We are not prisoners of fate. We are architects of it. Every wall you see was built by someone who believed it could not be moved.
author: Morpheus

text: A dream within a dream is still a dream. The only thing that matters is whether you wake up.
author: Dom Cobb

text: Love is not limited by time or space. It is the one force in the universe that transcends both.
author: Cooper

text: The question is not whether reality is an illusion. The question is whether it matters.
author: Truman Burbank

text: Loneliness is not the absence of people. It is the absence of connection. And connection requires the courage to be seen.
author: Violet Evergarden

text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts: therefore make good wishes, and care that they be good.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
author: Epictetus

text: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
author: Epictetus

text: One must imagine Sisyphus happy.
author: Albert Camus

text: The absurd is born of the confrontation between the human need and the unreasonable silence of the world.
author: Albert Camus

text: Life can only be understood in reverse; but it must be lived in the forward direction.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

text: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

text: The meaning of life is just to be alive. It is so plain and so obvious and so simple. Yet, everybody rushes around in great panic as if it were necessary to achieve something beyond themselves.
author: Alan Watts

text: The only way to make sense out of change is to plunge into it, move with it, and join the dance.
author: Alan Watts

text: The universe is not required to be in perfect harmony with human ambition.
author: Carl Sagan

text: We are a way for the cosmos to know itself.
author: Carl Sagan

text: Be prepared to accept uncertainty. The world is far more unpredictable than we are comfortable admitting.
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb

text: The world is nonlinear. A small input can produce enormous effects. Plan accordingly.
author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
